hero.heading: Ideas That Matter. Research That Informs. Policies That Transform.
hero.text: An independent, non-partisan public policy institution advancing liberty, democratic governance and development through critical inquiry, independent scholarship and transformative policy vision.
hero.subline: Bridging Knowledge, Policy, and Public Purpose.

about.heading: About CRGD
about.text:
The Centre for Research on Governance and Development (CRGD): The Public Policy Bridge is an independent, non-partisan research and advocacy institution dedicated to advancing liberty, knowledge, democracy, accountable governance, and development.

Founded on the conviction that public policy must be informed by evidence, guided by reason, and judged by its outcomes, CRGD seeks to bridge the divide between academic scholarship, institutions, and the realities of society.
about.statement: CRGD stands for the liberty, the responsibility to reason, and the imperative to reform and responsible interventions.

centres.heading: Eighteen verticals, one standard of evidence
centres.text: Each research vertical is led by people who know its subject and its institutions. Choose a vertical to see its questions, its people and its publications.

programs.heading: Learn public policy by doing it
programs.text: Fellowships, internships, campus clubs and the CRGD Academy offer a way in for students, young professionals and mid career practitioners.

founder.quote: At CRGD, we believe that ideas must withstand scrutiny, institutions must be responsible, and development must ultimately enlarge human freedom.

subscribe.heading: Subscribe to email updates
subscribe.text: One email a fortnight with our newest research, upcoming events and calls for applications. No spam, and you can unsubscribe at any time.

support.heading: Support CRGD: The Public Policy Bridge
support.text: Independent research depends on people who value it. Your contribution funds fellowships, field work and free public events, and it never buys a conclusion.
